summary: Delixy Holdings Limited furnished a Form 6-K on October 14, 2026, disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications letter dated October 13, 2026, confirming regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement. The deficiency arose from a 30-business-day shortfall from March 11 to April 22, 2026, with a 180-day cure period ending October 20, 2026. A 1-for-5 reverse share split took effect September 28, 2026, lifting the closing bid above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days. Nasdaq closed the matter. Watch for recurring delisting risk if the bid slips again.
